state: Finished-product planning audit of Canlang at cf36983c768c32e0a63ac33c3b45a94dc75dc2d3, October 6 2026. This is a materially new supported-host/publication decision; previous port consultations selected a retained staged native preparation job, not its host matrix or package topology. Purpose: economical reliable AI-authored SaaS, preserving complete current CLI build/preview/confirmed publication, failure order, cleanup, integrity and rollback. Rust native preparation is a standalone Cloudflare-owned crate; TS/Bun host retains syntax parsing, owner catalogs, activation, review/apply. There are no actual Rust/native performance or packaged-launch proofs yet. P09 requires package-local reproducible builds and per-supported-host executable inventory at cloudflare/dist/preparation/<supported-platform>/can-preparation[.exe], licenses/release/protocol metadata; normal users must not install a compiler. C01 explicitly decides supported hosts from actual CLI consumers and claims, rather than promise every Node platform. Existing root Node support is >=22; Bun is pinned 1.4.2; cloudflare package files=[dist], bin=can-platform; no explicit OS/architecture native support matrix exists. Therefore this question does not invent exact supported hosts. Current installed CLI has additional unresolved checkout assumptions: release facts need compiler/Cargo.toml/root package.json and worker inventory references packages/*/dist. Packaged executable launch alone cannot certify installed build/deploy. These are independent mandatory release obligations for each choice. Values/work Wasm assets must stay outside native executable packaging and use typed Worker module inventory. Selecting native then replaying semantic failures in TS is prohibited; backend selection occurs before a job. Existing TS CLI domain/support may remain on TS with honest backend provenance. Full API behavior and error/order parity plus actual installed consumer proof and same-artifact rollback are required for any enabled profile. Native default is gated measured complete-job budgets, not presumed Rust speed. Compare equal command outcomes, user install cost, package complexity, portability/support clarity and rollback; qualified native coverage may be narrower than the preserved public TS support. Do not infer guarantees from advice. Native support contract and publication topology are separately revisable, not a fixed worker-count decision. Additional verified current release evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml and docs/install.md provide the compiler CLI only for linux-x86_64 and macos-aarch64; Windows native support is not claimed. Initial native preparation qualification may nominate these existing CLI hosts but requires its own actual build/launch and installed-consumer proofs; compiler release presence proves neither native binary. Current Node library release packs only contracts/cloudflare/testkit/state/values despite interfaces runtime dependency, so full producer package closure must be repaired independently of executable topology.

native_support.instructions: For the finished Canlang product, select the native-host commitment that most reliably keeps all current CLI behavior available and adds only evidenced native support.

criteria.qualified_opt_in: Preserve current TS host support; publish an explicit verified native OS/architecture matrix after actual build/launch/installed-consumer proof. Native is opt-in on qualified hosts; unsupported selection fails before job, with no automatic fallback. Later defaults require measurements. Least unsupported promise; two supported backends persist during rollout.
criteria.native_all_claimed_hosts: Require native implementations for every presently supported CLI OS/architecture before release adoption, while retaining TS until that matrix is proved. Same public behavior; broader native support target and larger build/test burden, but simpler eventual default coverage.
criteria.prepared_ts_only: Keep prepared TS as the delivered CLI everywhere and defer native distribution until stronger consumer demand/measurement exists. Same CLI outcomes/rollback, smallest installation/support cost, but leaves accepted native preparation target and external native reuse unmet.

native_publication.instructions: Given identical qualified hosts and CLI semantics, choose the first distribution structure with the strongest simplicity, integrity, installed-flow and rollback tradeoff.

criteria.bundled_binaries: Ship qualified-host binaries and notices inside the owning Cloudflare dist with a pinned path resolver and explicit size/integrity inventory. One package/install route and existing stamp ownership; downloads include other hosts binaries and package size grows.
criteria.optional_host_packages: Ship one signed/integrity-checked package per qualified host as optional dependencies and a deterministic resolver with install-policy evidence. Smaller downloads, but more release identities/package graph and optional-install failure cases; no user compiler.
criteria.installation_download: Download the exact qualified-host release binary during install or first setup with pinned digest, cache/offline/cleanup policy, explicit network and failure evidence. Smaller main package and flexible releases, but adds external install network and trust/availability obligations.
